Record notes

Browse 104 original fictional brand kits with editable sources, previews and local MCP handoffs.

Version 0.1.1 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Full audited 104-kit collection and runtime; separate Fresh Curiosity A2 assets excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; MCP Apps supporting host for the chooser.

License scope: MIT original code and kits; bundled fonts retain SIL OFL notices. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add brand-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 6ed6d74f97eac8279192dc9d954bae2a176b85fb. SHA-256: 7d34752e5cf96767e4a2ddbd181b7e959596a61f3aab0c1f236cdd5db457a899.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
